messages:
emily: Weekly account pulse for LuminaPay onboarding 
Overall: usage steady but error rate spike in last 2h. 5xx = 3.5% (+1.8ppt), timeouts = 1.4% (+0.9ppt), 429s = 0.7% (+0.2ppt). Need top failing endpoints and quick mitigation. :mag:
tyler: Pulled errors (90m): top endpoints by 5xx volume: /v1/embeddings/batch (42%), /v1/chat/stream (28%), /v1/generate (12%), /events/ingest (9%), /v1/batch/run (6%). Sample logs:
```
2026-02-05T15:10:04Z ERROR 504 POST /v1/embeddings/batch job=eb_900 lat=5120ms
2026-02-05T15:11:12Z ERROR 502 POST /v1/chat/stream id=ch_77 lat=1250ms
2026-02-05T15:12:30Z WARN 429 POST /v1/generate user=acct_lumina token_bucket=0.0
```
nora: Note: runtime change yesterday adjusted KV cache retry policy (retries 2->0) and batch-worker concurrency bump in prod (10->14). Combined with customer increasing client parallelism (reported) explains higher downstream queueing.
devops-bot: autoscale-bot: embeddings-pool scaled +1 at 15:20:05Z; cpu spike detected at 15:09Z; no recent rollbacks.
tyler: Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle edge max batch for LuminaPay to 1024, 2) temporarily increase embeddings-pool by +1 more, 3) enable warm prefix-KV preloads for their onboarding prefixes. Ops can do (2) now; edge throttle needs config push (~15m).
emily: Ops please bump now. I'll message the CSM to ask LuminaPay to pause parallel workers. Jess-style note: tell them we expect improvement within 20m after capacity bump.
tyler: Ops bumped embeddings-pool +1 at 15:22Z. Early telemetry: embeddings 504s down from 3.8% -> 1.1% in 7m; overall 5xx now 1.9%. Chat stream still marginally elevated; will follow up.
nora: Opening incident INC-20260205-LUM-001, adding logs and top endpoints. Assigning eng-runtime and infra.
emily: Thanks. Hold for 1h, then reassess renewal flag if stable. Will update CSM and schedule a short post-mortem if rollback required. :white_check_mark:
